# kener_page (Data Source)

Fetches a single Kener status page by its `page_path` (use `~home` for the built-in home page).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kener_page" "home" {
  page_path = "~home"
}

output "home_monitors" {
  value = data.kener_page.home.monitors
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_path` (String) The page slug to look up (`~home` for the home page).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal numeric identifier.
- `monitors` (List of String) Ordered list of monitor tags shown on the page.
- `page_header` (String) Page header.
- `page_logo` (String) Page logo URL.
- `page_settings` (String) Page display settings as stored by Kener (JSON).
- `page_subheader` (String) Page subheader.
- `page_title` (String) Page title.
